body:
🤖 Installed extraction is now draft [PR #50](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/pull/50), head `a3c7f83f`, stacked on exact #46 dependency `1f6e7fe2`. Exact title/body, draft/open state, label, head/base and both successful GitHub checks were read back and verified. It remains unmerged. [Source and results](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/8053eb2c/experiments/48-generation-manifest/installed-results.md).

The locked suite passes 105 tests plus lint/format/types/all hooks. [Actual installed proof](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/8053eb2c/experiments/48-generation-manifest/installed-proof.json): 353 official source files / 2,419,604 bytes, seven pinned writer members, all eight controller assets byte-identical, ten prepared task members with modes/grading preserved. Only native TOML reproducibility metadata differs. Completed handoff repeats byte-inert; fresh planning admits nothing. Source cache survives default imports unchanged. Global network, subprocess, credential and research-runtime-code access were forbidden. [Actual SDK profile](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/8053eb2c/experiments/48-generation-manifest/installed-sdk-profile.json) independently matches the recorded Python 3.12 SDK; no client connection or worker availability claim.

The real source proof caught two generic acquisition defects: the historical writer directory included four interpreter-cache files, and its seven canonical wheel records needed the inventory API’s path ordering. These metadata contracts were corrected from the pinned original wheel, leaving original caches, official source and task assets untouched. [Partial attempts](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/8053eb2c/experiments/48-generation-manifest/installed-partial-proof-records.json) remain preserved. A source-only successful CLI exit without a final artifact was not counted as a full proof; the final fourth attempt is authoritative. Documentation also clarifies that paid-model status is not an approval gate; the original admission-closure policy was not relaxed.

[Cleanup record](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/a883a801/experiments/48-generation-manifest/local-cleanup.json): verified archived receipts and exact wheel/source hashes, then removed eight duplicate software/test trees (24,371 regular files; 416,661,809 logical bytes, not a claim of physical disk reclaimed). Retained the complete proof/source cache, exact artifacts and a clean installed candidate runtime. No task-owned `/tmp` data or active controller/job. Original large traces remain in previously verified HF snapshots; new small metadata/code is permanent Git evidence. The app PR-attachment endpoint did not return; the GitHub PR itself is independently verified and linked.

No model call, regeneration, native control run, new unique task or spending occurred. Original 191 generation files, original prepared baseline and global ledger remain unchanged; native scientific acceptance remains unproved. New actual epic child [#51](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/issues/51) targets generic held-control retention without per-task whitelists or score repair. Keep this issue/epic open, no next native admission or auto merge/release.
